Senses.Explanation: The first half of the inherited Lotus couplet: the thing rests in its place, the world's look stays constant. Yunmen Wenyan raises the sutra's line about the thing resting in its place and asks where old Shakyamuni has gone, Yongming Yanshou sets the couplet inside the one-nature reading, where knowing the law's own no-nature is why one vehicle is taught, Dahui Zonggao says whoever settles the two lines nets the world's way and the beyond-world's way in one cast, and Gulin Qingmao asks how, the thing resting and the world's look constant, old Shakyamuni managed to lose his nose. Zhongfeng Mingben turns the couplet against stopping, asking whether mind or scene can be stopped when the thing rests and the world's look stays, Hanyue Fazang runs it with the whole world cold and the whole world hot, every dust and every land the same from before the sages, Miyun Yuanwu reads it into the rice shoots and mulberry-picking of early summer, where knowing the constant look gives standing ground, and Baishan Dekai doubles it, heaven not not-heaven and water still water, and rules that taken one way the study of a lifetime is done, taken the other way you shoot into hell like an arrow.
